name: Force Palm
description:
You thrust your palm outward with such strength that a shockwave is sent towards a creature. Make a ranged or melee attack roll, depending on your target.

If used as a melee attack, deal {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or higher, the target is paralyzed.

If used as a ranged attack, the range is 20 feet, and the damage is halved with no chance to paralyze.
